images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape three-panel storyboard for Speaker Coach project documentation. Create a polished, readable editorial illustration of a person in a remote interview using a private second screen for visual coaching. Three equal panels reading left to right, generous white space, warm off-white background, navy outlines and muted teal accents, warm natural human expressions. Same dark-haired adult interviewee wearing a teal shirt appears in each panel; interviewer appears on the laptop video call. Coaching guidance is visible only on the interviewee's separate display, not spoken and not broadcast to the interviewer. Short exact English labels in a clean large sans-serif. No invented logos or watermarks. Concept of intended future behavior, not an actual screenshot. Title: "Direct question". Panel 1 label "Listen": interviewer asks "What are your strengths?" Panel 2 label "Reflect": interviewee pauses thoughtfully and says "My main strengths..." while coach holds the question visible. Panel 3 label "Answer": interviewee responds confidently; prominent private coaching display contains only three bullet cues: "Relevant skill", "Real example", "Value to the role". Make the 3-step progression and the private screen easy to understand, with simple arrows between panels. This is recall support, not a full answer script.
